title: Drop the caffe2 and torch protobuf string wrappers
body:
`proto_wrap` defines `GetEmptyStringAlreadyInited` in three namespaces. Only
`ONNX_NAMESPACE` is reachable: `cmake/Dependencies.cmake:1394` hands
`ProtoBufPatch.cmake` to ONNX as its post-build script, ONNX passes
`-DNAMESPACES=${ONNX_NAMESPACE}`, and the rewritten `.pb.h` calls the unqualified
name. The bundled protobuf 3.21.12 still emits it, so that path is live.

The `caffe2` and `torch` copies were fed by `caffe2_protobuf_generate_cpp_py`,
which now has no callers: the repository has no `.proto` files outside
`third_party`. Nothing calls either `ShutdownProtobufLibrary`.

`ProtoBufPatch.cmake` keeps its `NOT SYSTEM_PROTOBUF` guard. The deleted function
was the only thing that set it, but flattening the script is pure reindentation.

Authored with an AI assistant.
